summary: OFA Group filed an 8-K to disclose a Real World Asset Tokenization Service Agreement with Vero 60 LLC and Vero Beach Land Development LLC. The registrant will provide blockchain tokenization services for a Florida real estate development in exchange for a $7.5 million platform fee, payable in two milestones. The company explicitly disclaims roles as issuer or broker. This is a service contract, not a special situation transaction.
